scenarios.name: sketch-preferences-06 Escape discards an uncommitted Axes change

scenario_steps.name: Axes is checked in Sketch preferences
the user unchecks Axes
OK and enabled Cancel and Apply controls appear
the user presses Escape without applying and reopens the Sketch page
Axes is checked again

scenarios.name: sketch-preferences-07 HUD input controls disable their coordinate modes

scenario_steps.name: Pointer Input is enabled with Cartesian Coordinates
Dimension Input is enabled with Polar Coordinates
the user unchecks Enable Pointer Input
its coordinate radio controls are disabled
the dimension coordinate controls remain active
the user unchecks Enable Dimension Input
its coordinate radio controls are disabled too
the user clicks Cancel and reopens HUD Settings
both input checkboxes are checked again
Pointer Cartesian and Dimension Polar selections are restored
the user presses Escape twice
HUD Settings and Application Options close in sequence

scenarios.name: sketch-preferences-08 Apply Axes off reopen and restore

scenario_steps.name: Axes is checked on Sketch preferences page
the user unchecks Axes and clicks Apply
Apply becomes disabled and Close is displayed
the user closes Application Options
the long sketch-axis line is absent while the global view triad remains
the user reopens Application Options
Axes remains unchecked
the user checks Axes and applies and closes
the long sketch-axis line returns
